item.title: A Weekend MCP-AQL Adapter for MakerPerks
item.description: My friend Nate Aune built MakerPerks, a directory of builder perks. I built an MCP-AQL adapter for it so my agents can query it directly instead of walking through a web interface.

item.title: About
item.description: Builder, maker, tinkerer. Currently working on Dollhouse Research, DollhouseMCP, MCP-AQL, and AILIS. Background in media/tech, product, and AI tools.
